curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8063-1-1.pdf (book 1: the tractor, steps 1-54) and 8063-1-2.pdf (book 2: tractor steps 55-62, then the trailer; page 79 shows both finished). Neither book has a functions page.

functions.does: The black 20 tooth gear on the cab roof steers the front wheels: its shaft runs down to a pair of knob wheels, which turn a shaft running forward to two 16 tooth gears and on to two 8 tooth gears on the steering rack.
functions.source: book 1 steps 13-15 (knob wheels and 16 tooth gears) and the steering under the engine; the roof gear on book 2 page 79; that this is the steering is inferred from the model's gears

functions.does: The steering wheel in the cab turns on an axle pin but isn't joined to the steering.
functions.source: inferred: in the model it sits on an axle pin (p192 3749) with nothing below it
functions.note: Unsure: it may be meant to steer as well.

functions.does: The rear wheels drive through a differential, and the four pistons of the engine under the bonnet pump as the tractor rolls: a 12 tooth double bevel gear on the differential turns a shaft running forward, whose 16 tooth gear turns the crankshaft through a 16 tooth idler.
functions.source: book 1 step 5 (differential), steps 24-29 (engine, crankshaft and gears)
functions.note: With one rear wheel held, the other turns the opposite way through the differential.

functions.does: The red lever on the tractor's left side slides a driving ring along the drive shaft, locking the 16 tooth clutch gear to it or freeing it.
functions.source: book 1 step 12 (the inset shows the lever and the ring)
functions.note: Unsure which way is engaged and how far the lever swings.

functions.does: With the lever engaged, the rear power take-off turns as the tractor rolls: the clutch gear drives a 16 tooth gear above it, whose shaft runs back to the PTO at the rear.
functions.source: book 1 steps 5-12; inferred from the model's gears that the clutch gear drives the PTO
functions.note: Unsure what the ring engages; it could instead couple the engine. The amount for the lever is a guess.

functions.does: The black knob behind the cab raises and lowers the rear three-point linkage: it turns a vertical worm, which turns a 24 tooth crown gear on a cross axle; bent liftarms on that axle lift the lower links through two long beams.
functions.source: book 1 steps 9-11 (worm, crown gear and cross axle); book 2 step 56 (lift links)

functions.does: Either of the two gears at the front of the trailer, one on each side, tips the trailer's bed: a cross axle with a 20 tooth bevel gear turns a 12 tooth bevel gear on the linear actuator, whose piston pushes the front of the bed up while it pivots at the back.
functions.source: book 2 trailer steps 12-15 (linear actuator), step 30 (page 77, bed tipped) and page 79

functions.does: The trailer's drawbar is hitched behind the tractor and swivels on its pin, so the trailer follows round bends.
functions.source: book 2 page 79 (the inset shows the hitch)
functions.note: Nothing is worked by hand; checked by steering and rolling the tractor with the trailer behind.

functions.does: The trailer's four wheels roll freely.
Each side's two trailer wheels sit at the ends of a beam that rocks on its middle, so all four stay on the ground.
functions.source: inferred: the 11 long beams (p708 32525, p842 32525) carry a wheel at each end; the book doesn't show them rocking
functions.note: Unsure: the beams may be fixed.

functions.does: A short chain hangs from the trailer's drawbar.

questions.question: What does the red lever engage?
